actions.name: rule_set
actions.description: Create or update an automation rule (id absent = create): a trigger, optional AND conditions, and a kernel-routed action dispatched when it fires, with optional cooldown and its own requires_confirmation flag. The rule keeps firing unattended afterwards, so this installs a standing capability rather than performing a one-off act.

id.description: Absent = create (assigns id); present = update (engine state preserved).

event_type.description: Fully-qualified kernel event type, e.g. plugin.calendar.due or plugin.scheduler.fired. Must be in AUTOMATIONS_PLUGIN_EVENT_TYPES.

path.description: JSON pointer into the event payload ('' = whole payload).

equals.description: Exact value the pointed value must equal.

conditions.description: All conditions must hold (AND). Empty = always.

action.description: Kernel-routed action dispatched when the rule fires; runs under automations' own JWT grants (T-19 — operator must grant gated targets).

requires_confirmation.description: true = never auto-dispatch; publishes a needs_confirmation event until re-set with false.

actions.name: rule_get
actions.description: Fetch one automation rule by id with its trigger, conditions and action. Read-only.

actions.name: rule_list
actions.description: List automation rules with their ids, names and enabled state. Read-only.

actions.name: rule_delete
actions.description: Delete an automation rule by id. Irreversible, and it can remove a rule something else depends on.

AUTOMATIONS_PLUGIN_EVENT_TYPES.description: Comma-separated kernel event types this plugin may subscribe to and match rules on. Default-deny when empty.
